en: Sepia-toned historic postcard-style photograph of a large neo-Renaissance public building with a central entrance portico, ornate columns, and arched windows, set within a landscaped park with paths, lawns, young trees, and gas-style street lamps. A street with tram or rail tracks runs in the foreground. Below the image is a modern archival strip with a scale and library credit labels.
